# WindowSwitcherConfig

> **File:** `config/WindowSwitcherConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the WindowSwitcher section (Alt+Tab). Named WindowSwitcherConfig because `WindowSwitcher` is the shell module type.

### Properties

- `scope` (readonly string): all | monitor | workspace (DockLayout.inScope's scopes)
- `previews` (readonly bool)
- `tileSize` (readonly int)
- `showDelay` (readonly int)
